Collect geo-point data for one request

Source: R/collect.R
collect_point.Rd

The single entry point of the C6 contract. Dispatches a geo_point_request() to its registered source adapter and returns a verified geo_point_series, or a structured refusal when the source is unknown or its package is not installed.

Usage

collect_point(
  request,
  retrieved_at = NULL,
  offline = getOption("terroir.offline", FALSE)
)

Arguments

request

A geo_point_request from geo_point_request().

retrieved_at

Optional character scalar timestamp (provenance). Defaults to the current time. Ignored in offline mode (a replayed series keeps the fixture's recorded timestamp).

offline

Logical scalar. When TRUE, answer from a recorded fixture with zero network egress (see Details). Defaults to the terroir.offline option, otherwise FALSE.

Value

A geo_point_series, or a terroir_refusal – including when the returned values fail the value-plausibility conformer (an implausible NDVI/EVI or temperature reading), which is refused rather than aborted so one bad cell does not stop a multi-site collection.

Details

collect_point() performs network input/output, so it stamps retrieved_at with the current time by default; pass retrieved_at for reproducible runs.

In offline mode (offline = TRUE, or globally via options(terroir.offline = TRUE)) the request is answered from a recorded fixture with no network egress at all: the matching cached series is replayed with its provenance marked replayed = TRUE and its original retrieved_at preserved (see is_replayed()). This lets a sovereign-coordinate trial run with zero upstream contact, and makes a pipeline reproducible bit-for-bit. When no recorded fixture answers the request, offline mode returns a structured refusal rather than silently falling back to the network. The fixture directory is the terroir.fixture_dir option if set, otherwise the installed package's fixtures/ directory.

See also

geo_point_request(), list_sources(), verify_geo_series(), is_replayed()

Examples

req <- geo_point_request(
  lon = 138.6, lat = -34.92,
  start = "2020-01-01", end = "2020-01-10",
  variables = c("T2M", "PRECTOTCORR"),
  source = "nasapower"
)
# offline = TRUE answers from the shipped fixture -- no network egress
series <- collect_point(req, offline = TRUE)
series

#> [1] TRUE

# an unknown source returns a structured refusal, never an error
out <- collect_point(geo_point_request(0, 0, source = "not_a_source"))
#> Warning: terroir refused: unknown source 'not_a_source' (see list_sources())
is_refusal(out)
#> [1] TRUE
